# lime-csr-js

Version: 0.6.3
Architecture: Unprivileged Micro-Kernel + Discrete Modules  
Type: Browser-First Client-Side Rendering Engine  
CSP: Compatible with script-src 'self' (Eval-Free)

---

## 1. Executive Summary

lime-csr-js is an eval-free, client-side rendering engine built on standard browser APIs. Templates remain native HTML `<template>` elements. An unprivileged Micro-Kernel handles generic routing, lifecycle execution, prototypal scoping, and unified LIFO cleanups. Template composition (`<partial>` and `<slot>`) is built into the runtime, while behavioral features (conditionals, loops, text, visibility, form binding, event delegation, and DOM element references) are discrete extensible modules.

---

## 2. Package Exports & Subpaths

```js
// Root: Facade, Store, Diagnostics, Kernel Primitives, Standard Modules
import { mount, unmount, render, createStore, createEngine, defineModule } from 'lime-csr-js';

// Core: Kernel Primitives only (alternative direct subpath import)
// import { createEngine, defineModule, attr, attrs, tag, pattern, createScope } from 'lime-csr-js/core';

// Modules: 8 Standard Modules
import { partials, conditionals, loops, text, show, model, events, ref } from 'lime-csr-js/modules';

// Single Module import (alternative granular import)
// import show from 'lime-csr-js/modules/show';
// import ref from 'lime-csr-js/modules/ref';

// Browser / CDN distribution (jsDelivr GitHub CDN)
// Full bundle: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/mhmtsnmzkanly/lime-csr-js@v0.6.3/dist/index.min.js'
// Micro-Kernel: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/mhmtsnmzkanly/lime-csr-js@v0.6.3/dist/core.min.js'
// Standalone Store: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/mhmtsnmzkanly/lime-csr-js@v0.6.3/dist/store.min.js'
// Discrete Modules: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/mhmtsnmzkanly/lime-csr-js@v0.6.3/dist/modules/{text,show,events,model,conditionals,loops,partials,ref}.min.js'
```

---

## 3. Core Facade API

```js
// Mount template into DOM container (CSS selector or Element)
const instance = mount({
  target: '#app',
  template: 'templateName',
  store: reactiveStore,
  context: { staticKey: 'value' },  // Read once during transform (${staticKey})
  handlers: {                        // Event handlers for data-on-*
    handleClick({ event, element, scope, store, data, refs }) { /* application logic */ },
  },
  computed: {                        // Registered automatically on store
    isReady: { deps: ['items'], fn: (items) => items.length > 0 },
  },
});
// instance.refs: Map of DOM elements registered via data-ref

// Teardown
unmount(instance); // or unmount('#app');

// In-place rendering of arbitrary fragments
const renderResult = render(fragment, { store, context, handlers }); // renderResult.refs, callable cleanup
```

---

## 4. Reactive Store API

State paths are dot-separated strings (e.g. `"user.name"`). Upward and downward path changes trigger automatically. Subscriptions are garbage-collected upon unmount.

```js
import { createStore } from 'lime-csr-js';

const store = createStore({ count: 0, user: { name: 'Alice' } });

store.get('user.name');                   // "Alice"
store.set('user.name', 'Bob');            // Notifies subscribers
store.update('count', (n) => n + 1);      // Functional update
store.subscribe('count', (newVal, old) => {}); // Returns unsubscribe function
store.batch(() => {                       // Coalesces notifications into 1 flush wave
  store.set('count', 10);
  store.set('user.name', 'Charlie');
});
store.computed('doubled', ['count'], (c) => c * 2);
```

Security: `__proto__`, `constructor`, and `prototype` are rejected as path segments.

---

## 5. Micro-Kernel & Module Contract

### Kernel vs Module Separation
- **Kernel = Mechanism:** Triggers, route compilation, precedence, prototypal scope, lifecycle runner, unified cleanup stack, diagnostics. Zero feature semantics.
- **Module = Behavior:** Conditionals, loops, partials, text, form model, events, DOM element references.

### Defining a Custom Module (`defineModule`)

```js
import { defineModule, attr } from 'lime-csr-js';

export const tooltip = defineModule({
  name: 'tooltip', // /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/
  version: '1.0.0',
  triggers: [
    attr('data-tooltip', {
      phase: 'link', // 'transform' | 'link'

      read(el, ctx) {
        // Pure extraction, executed ONCE during initial setup
        return { text: el.getAttribute('data-tooltip') };
      },

      setup(el, data, ctx) {
        if (!data?.text) return;
        const handler = () => { el.title = data.text; };
        el.addEventListener('mouseenter', handler);

        // Auto-cleanup on unified LIFO stack
        ctx.onCleanup(() => el.removeEventListener('mouseenter', handler));
      },
    }),
  ],
});
```

### Composing a Custom Engine (`createEngine`)

```js
import { createEngine } from 'lime-csr-js';
import { text, show, events } from 'lime-csr-js/modules';
import { tooltip } from './tooltip.js';

// Precedence is determined by array order: earlier modules take precedence.
const engine = createEngine({
  modules: [tooltip, text(), show(), events()],
});

engine.mount({ target, template: 'app', store });
```

---

## 6. Trigger Primitives

- `attr(name, hooks)`: Matches exact attribute name (e.g. `data-show`).
- `attrs({ required: ['a', 'b'], optional: ['c'], phase }, hooks)`: Matches multi-attribute group. Anchored to first required attribute.
- `tag(name, hooks)`: Matches exact HTML tag name (normalized to uppercase, e.g. `PARTIAL`).
- `pattern(prefixOrRegex, hooks)`: Matches attribute name prefix (`data-on-`) or RegExp.

---

## 7. Execution Phases: Transform vs Link

1. **Phase 1: Transform (Fixed-Point Macro Expansion):**
   - Structural DOM mutations allowed (`replaceWith`, `appendChild`, `remove`).
   - Runs in a loop until DOM stabilizes (max 100 passes).
   - Modules: `partials`, `conditionals`, `loops`, `resolveStatic`.
2. **Phase 2: Link (Single-Pass Traversal):**
   - Zero structural mutations allowed. Topology is frozen.
   - Visited once in tree order.
   - Attaches event listeners, store watches (`ctx.watch`), two-way model bindings, element references.
   - Modules: `model`, `text`, `show`, `events`, `ref`, live conditional/loop anchors.

---

## 8. ModuleContext (`ctx`)

Available in trigger hooks:
- `ctx.scope`: Lexical template scope with native prototypal inheritance.
- `ctx.store`: Reactive Store instance.
- `ctx.element`: Current DOM element.
- `ctx.document`: Owning Document.
- `ctx.matchedAttribute`: Matched attribute name.
- `ctx.refs`: Shared DOM element references map for active mount/render runtime.
- `ctx.onCleanup(fn)`: Registers cleanup callback on unified LIFO stack.
- `ctx.watch(path, cb, opts?)`: Watches store path; auto-registers cleanup.
- `ctx.afterConnect(fn)`: Schedules callback after element is connected to DOM.
- `ctx.update(fnOrArg?)`: Runs update callback with error isolation.
- `ctx.error(code, details)` / `ctx.warn(code, msg)`: Centralized diagnostics.

---

## 9. The 8 Standard Modules Syntax

1. **`partials`** (Transform):
   `<partial name="user-card" data="currentUser" role="admin"><h3 slot="header">Title</h3><p>Body in default slot</p></partial>`
   - Built-in template composition. Supports named (`<slot name="...">`) and default (`<slot>`) slots with fallback content.
   - Partial template nodes run in isolated scope; projected slot children retain caller lexical scope.
   - Projection metadata stripped (`slot` attribute removed from output DOM). Unknown slots emit `SLOT_NOT_FOUND`.
2. **`conditionals`** (Transform + Link):
   `<if is-truthy="user.loggedIn" data-live>`
     `<p>Hello</p>`
     `<else><p>Sign in</p></else>`
   `</if>`
   - Operators: `is-gt`, `is-lt`, `is-gte`, `is-lte`, `is-eq`, `is-neq`, `is-truthy`.
   - In tables: use `<template data-if is-truthy="...">`.
3. **`loops`** (Transform + Link):
   `<for each="items" as="item" index="i" key="item.id" data-live data-diff="lcs">`
     `<li>${i}: <span data-text="item.name"></span></li>`
   `</for>`
   - Prototypal scope per item. Diff strategies: `simple`, `lcs`, `replace`.
4. **`text`** (Link):
   `<span data-text="user.name"></span>`
   `<a href="/users/{id}" data-id="user.id">Profile</a>`
   - Sets `textContent` (HTML injection safe). URL attributes protocol sanitized.
5. **`show`** (Link):
   `<div data-show="isVisible"></div>`
   - Sets native `hidden` property. Does not alter inline `style.display`.
6. **`model`** (Link):
   `<input type="text" data-model="query">`
   `<input type="checkbox" data-model="roles[]" value="admin">`
   `<form data-model-group="user"><input name="name"></form>`
   - Two-way binding with cursor preservation, checkbox arrays (`path[]`), contenteditable, modifiers (`.lazy`, `.trim`, `.number`, `.debounce-<ms>`), and initial DOM fallback.
7. **`events`** (Link):
   `<button data-on-click="handleClick" data-on-click-data="item.id">Save</button>`
   `<input data-on-keydown-enter="submit">`
   - Delegated on mount target. Receives `{ event, element, scope, store, data, refs }`. Prevents default on submit. Prototype-safe. Isolated async/sync error reporting.
8. **`ref`** (Link):
   `<input data-ref="searchBox">`
   `<li data-ref="items[]">Item</li>`
   - Binds DOM element(s) to `app.refs` and passes `refs` into event handler payloads. Duplicate names without `[]` auto-group into array. Automatically dereferenced on unmount.

---

## 10. Rules for Coding with Lime-CSR

- **NEVER use `eval()` or `new Function()`:** Lime is strictly eval-free.
- **NEVER use removed Plugin APIs:** `definePlugin`, `PLUGIN_API_VERSION`, `engine.use()`, `adaptPluginToModule` DO NOT EXIST.
- **NEVER mutate arrays in-place without new reference:** `store.update('list', l => [...l, item])`.
- **NEVER place `<if>` or `<for>` directly inside `<table>` or `<select>`:** Browser foster-parenting moves them. Use `<template data-if>` or `<template data-for>`.
- **ALWAYS use `defineModule` for custom directives:** Follow the `read` + `setup` + `onCleanup` pattern.
